bandwagon_check: No popularity-based claims used. The only doc-consensus risk ('all tests pass / project done') is downgraded to single-build-origin because foreman-checkpoint.json and EXECUTION-LOG.md are the same build's self-report and pytest could not be re-run (E11,E12).
what_anchor_is: Single-user plain-markdown productivity system for J.C. Liechty (anchor_gui.py live server on :8777 + anchor.py CLI), plus a newer per-project 'R&D control surface' that launches the researchPrime/Crucible/Foreman trio as durable server-owned `claude -p` jobs and serves their reports.

findings.claim: Core product is a stdlib-only markdown task system; anchor_gui.py (~205KB) is the live NSSM-service app on port 8777, anchor.py is the mirrored CLI.

The product's 'Python stdlib only' contract is TRUE: flask/Pillow are imported only by the dead anchor_server.py and the optional create_shortcut.py icon helper, neither of which ships. requirements.txt is stale/misleading.

The R&D control surface (rnd_registry/job_runner/lanes/gate_adapter/effort_history/report_viewer/deliverables/distro) was Crucible-planned and Foreman-built across 9 waves; its gate reports 158->168 tests GREEN, status done/GO.
findings.dissent: Single build-origin (checkpoint + EXECUTION-LOG are the same run's self-report); pytest not re-run this session (E12).

findings.claim: The claude launch->stream->tail->report spine is live-proven: a real job in rnd_jobs/ invoked the researchPrime skill and wrote plan + ledger artifacts into the project namespace.

effort_history (versioned effort cards, cost rollup, C9 per-effort git auto-commit) is built + unit-tested but NOT wired into production: no production caller of record_effort/finalize_effort/attach_cost, and no index.json/efforts dirs on disk. Kanban cards + cost rollup are inert in prod.

The keystone gate mechanism (answer an AskUserQuestion stream-json frame via a stdin text turn) is self-described 'inherently FRAGILE/best-effort' and was tested only against a SYNTHETIC crucible_gate.jsonl; the real-Crucible live go/no-go was never run. Human SETUP gate is PENDING.
Gemini engine support is deferred to the research lane only (GEMINI_LANES={research}); the plan/build adapter is unbuilt; definition-of-done (green Crucible+Foreman dogfood on Gemini) not achieved.
Single-instance/exclusive-bind guard (SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE + clean exit on EADDRINUSE) shipped, resolving the duplicate-supervisor/stale-server saga (commits bb660a5, 31a3832).
findings.dissent: Resolution is recent (06-08/09); not soak-tested; overlaps the un-exercised real-host liveness risk.

findings.claim: anchor_server.py is dead legacy (Flask, port 5000, old 'Anchor PSU' layout, ignores paths.py, not shipped/referenced) - superseded by anchor_gui.py.
Working tree is dirty: 7 modified + 4 untracked paths uncommitted (incl. live rnd_registry.json, .anchor/, rnd_jobs/).
deliverables.py is a real product module with tests but is MISSING from dist_manifest.txt, so under the deny-by-default rule it would not ship.

findings.claim: Test suite (~29 test_*.py) covers job_runner durability/cancel, registry, token-auth, gate adapter, project window/Kanban, lanes concurrency, report viewer, deliverables, distro PII scan (10 planted-secret fixtures), engine selector, migration; isolates state via ANCHOR_DATA_DIR + a stdlib fake_claude mock (no live billing).
